title.english: The Other Side of a Day

pairs.target: nándé búyòng zǎoqǐ de bànrì , tǎ wéi fǎndǎo xiān xǐng le .
pairs.english: On a rare half day without an early start, Tavi woke first anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 难得不用早起的半日，塔维反倒先醒了。

pairs.target: tā zài chuángshàng fān le liǎnghuí , tīngjiàn chuāngwài yǒurén mài rè zhōu , zhōngyú chuānyī xiàlóu .
pairs.english: He rolled over twice in bed, heard someone selling hot porridge outside, and finally dressed and went downstairs.
pairs.hanzi: 他在床上翻了两回，听见窗外有人卖热粥，终于穿衣下楼。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng de mén hái guān zhe , yù hé yǐ tí zhe kōng lán chūmén , shuō zìjǐ yào zhǎo yìjiā mài gān huājiāo de , ruò tǎ wéi jīnrì yě xiǎng gēnzhe tā shù chē , tā biàn gǎi cóng hòuchuāng zǒu .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng's door remained shut. Yuhe was leaving with an empty basket to find dried Sichuan pepper; if Tavi wanted to follow her counting carts today too, she would use the back window instead.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡的门还关着，郁禾已提着空篮出门，说自己要找一家卖干花椒的，若塔维今日也想跟着她数车，她便改从后窗走。

pairs.target: tā chī guò zhōu , xún luó dí gěi de lù zhǎo qù .
pairs.english: After porridge he followed Luodi's directions.
pairs.hanzi: 他吃过粥，循罗荻给的路找去。

pairs.target: xiū tīzǐ de yuànzi zài pō bèi , dào le cái kànjiàn luó dí dūn zài bànshàn chēlún páng .
pairs.english: The ladder-repair courtyard was behind the slope; arriving, he found Luodi crouched beside a partly dismantled cart wheel.
pairs.hanzi: 修梯子的院子在坡背，到了才看见罗荻蹲在半扇车轮旁。

pairs.target: tīzǐ zuórì yǐjīng xiū wán , jīnrì yìng de chēzhóu què chāichū biéde máobìng , lúngū lǐ de jiù mù liè le , chēzhǔ zhèng gēn tángxiōng shāngliáng néng bunéng huàn yíkuài .
pairs.english: The ladder had been finished yesterday, but today's axle job had revealed another fault: old wood inside the hub was split, and the cart owner was discussing replacement with the cousin.
pairs.hanzi: 梯子昨日已经修完，今日应的车轴却拆出别的毛病，轮毂里的旧木裂了，车主正跟堂兄商量能不能换一块。

pairs.target: luó dí táitóu kànjiàn tā , xiān wèn shìbushì lái cuī gōng .
pairs.english: Luodi looked up and first asked whether he had come to hurry the work.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻抬头看见他，先问是不是来催工。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō jīnrì fàng bàntiān jiǎ , luó dí biàn jiāng zhānmǎn yóu de shǒu shēnxiàng tā de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi said he had half a day off, and Luodi reached his oily hand toward Tavi's sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说今日放半天假，罗荻便将沾满油的手伸向他的袖子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎnghòu tiào , tā xiào zhe shuō kànzhe dǎo bú xiàng yǒu shénme jíshì , jiào tā xiān děng , bié bǎ méi chāixiàlái de nà yíbàn luàn pèng .
pairs.english: Tavi jumped back. Laughing, Luodi said he seemed in no rush and should wait, keeping his hands off the half not yet dismantled.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往后跳，他笑着说看着倒不像有什么急事，叫他先等，别把没拆下来的那一半乱碰。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài ménkǎn shàng děng . tángxiōng shuō luó dí zuówǎn tíqǐ qīngchǎng de shì , yòu wèn nà zhī bēilǒu shì shuí de ,
pairs.english: Tavi sat waiting on the threshold. The cousin said Luodi had mentioned clearing the street last night, then asked whose basket it was.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在门槛上等。堂兄说罗荻昨晚提起清场的事，又问那只背篓是谁的，

pairs.target: tā shuō míngzì jiào bì lán , huà shuō chūkǒu cái fāxiànzìjǐ dácuò le , tángxiōng yě gēnzhe yí lèng , suíhòu xiào dé bǎ mùxiè chuījìn le lǐngkǒu .
pairs.english: He said its name was Bilan, realizing only after speaking that he had answered wrongly. The cousin paused too, then laughed hard enough to blow wood shavings into his collar.
pairs.hanzi: 他说名字叫碧岚，话说出口才发现自己答错了，堂兄也跟着一愣，随后笑得把木屑吹进了领口。

pairs.target: děng huàn mù de jiàqián tántuǒ , luó dí shōu hǎo chāi jiàn , tóng chēzhǔ yuēdìng míngzǎo lái zhuāng , cái xǐshǒu lǐng tǎ wéi chūqù .
pairs.english: Once the replacement wood's price was agreed, Luodi put away the removed parts, arranged installation with the owner for tomorrow morning, then washed his hands and led Tavi out.
pairs.hanzi: 等换木的价钱谈妥，罗荻收好拆件，同车主约定明早来装，才洗手领塔维出去。

pairs.target: yuàn hòu yǒu tiáo suìshí xiǎolù , chuānguò jǐ qí cài hé yípiàn dīǎi guǒshù , rào dào bújiàn jiù hú de lìngyímiàn .
pairs.english: A gravel path behind the yard crossed vegetable beds and low fruit trees, winding to the other side where the old arch vanished from sight.
pairs.hanzi: 院后有条碎石小路，穿过几畦菜和一片低矮果树，绕到不见旧弧的另一面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu le hěnjiǔméi huítóu , hūrán fāxiàn ěrbiān shǎo le zhènzǐ lǐ nà dào dī cháng de fēngshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi walked a long time without turning back, then suddenly noticed the town's low, drawn-out wind tone was gone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走了很久没回头，忽然发现耳边少了镇子里那道低长的风声。

pairs.target: qiánmiàn de xiǎo pō shàng dā zhe gòng lù rén xiējiǎo de péng , liǎngtóu chǎngkāi , péngwài shí yán xià jiùshì shēngǔ .
pairs.english: An open-ended resting shelter for travelers stood on the small slope ahead; beyond its stone ledge lay the deep valley.
pairs.hanzi: 前面的小坡上搭着供路人歇脚的棚，两头敞开，棚外石沿下就是深谷。

pairs.target: yún zài gǔdǐ fān , méi gāo guò tāmen jiǎo biān , yuǎnchù jǐtiáo shānjǐ xiàng géshuǐ lùchū de bèi , guāng cóng yún fèng luòxiàqù , jìng zhào chū gèng dī chù yípiàn shēnlǜ .
pairs.english: Clouds churned below their feet at the valley bottom. Distant ridges rose like backs above water, and light falling through a gap revealed a patch of deep green farther down.
pairs.hanzi: 云在谷底翻，没高过他们脚边，远处几条山脊像隔水露出的背，光从云缝落下去，竟照出更低处一片深绿。

pairs.target: nàlǐ háiyǒu shān , búshì tā cóng tú shàng xiǎng chūlái de yìzhěngkuài kòngbái .
pairs.english: There were mountains there too, not the single blank space he had imagined from maps.
pairs.hanzi: 那里还有山，不是他从图上想出来的一整块空白。

pairs.target: pénglǐ zuò zhe sìgè rén , sānzhī cháng bāo kào zài mùzhù páng .
pairs.english: Four people sat in the shelter, three long packs leaning against a wooden post.
pairs.hanzi: 棚里坐着四个人，三只长包靠在木柱旁。

pairs.target: yígè nǚrén zhèng jiāng shī wàzi nǐnggān , wàn biān chuí zhe báitáo pái , pái shàng liǎngdào héng hén .
pairs.english: A woman was wringing out wet socks, a white ceramic tally with two notches dangling by her wrist.
pairs.hanzi: 一个女人正将湿袜子拧干，腕边垂着白陶牌，牌上两道横痕。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bùyóu duō kàn le yìyǎn , luó dí yǐjīng tóng pángbiān ǎipàng nánrén dǎ qǐ zhāohū , shuō tā jīnnián bǐ qùnián huílái de zǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi could not help another look. Luodi was already greeting the short, stout man beside her, saying he had returned earlier this year than last.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不由多看了一眼，罗荻已经同旁边矮胖男人打起招呼，说他今年比去年回来得早。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō tíqián huí de shì zìjǐ , bié suàn zài zhěngduì tóushàng , hòutou háiyǒu rén liúzài shí wā bǔtú .
pairs.english: The man said only he had returned early, not the whole team; others were still back in the stone hollows filling gaps in the map.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说提前回的是自己，别算在整队头上，后头还有人留在石洼补图。

pairs.target: tā cóng bāo lǐ qǔchū jǐkǔn xìcháng de cǎo dài , wèn tángxiōng shàng huí yào de yàngzi shìbushì zhèzhǒng .
pairs.english: He took several bundles of slender grass bands from a pack, asking whether they were the kind Luodi's cousin had wanted last time.
pairs.hanzi: 他从包里取出几捆细长的草带，问堂兄上回要的样子是不是这种。

pairs.target: luó dí jiēguò lái mōlemō , shuō zìjǐ zhī lái chuánhuà , búhuì tìrén dāying jiàqián .
pairs.english: Luodi took them and felt them, saying he only passed on messages and could not agree to prices for someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻接过来摸了摸，说自己只来传话，不会替人答应价钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànkàn bái pái , yòu kàn nà piàn shēnlǜ , háishì kāikǒu wèn tāmen shìbushì cóng xiàmiàn huílái .
pairs.english: Tavi looked from the white tally to the green below, then asked whether they had returned from down there.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看看白牌，又看那片深绿，还是开口问他们是不是从下面回来。

pairs.target: nǚrén jiāng wàzi dā hǎo , shuō xiàmiàn hěndà , wèn nǎ yíchù . tā bìng méi búnàifán , tǎ wéi què zhēn dá bú shànglái , zhǐhǎo zhǐzhǐ yún fènglǐ lùchū de pō .
pairs.english: The woman hung her socks up and said down there was vast; which part? She was not impatient, but Tavi truly could not answer and could only point to the slope showing through the clouds.
pairs.hanzi: 女人将袜子搭好，说下面很大，问哪一处。她并没不耐烦，塔维却真答不上来，只好指指云缝里露出的坡。

pairs.target: " nàbiān hái méi qù . " tā shuō , " wǒmen rào de shì xīmiàn de shí wā . lùshang yǒu jǐjiā shōu yǔshuǐ de yuànzi , kāikǒu yào yán , búyào wǒmen dài de gān dòu . bái bèi lái liǎngdài , huílái hái dé zìjǐ chī . "
pairs.english: “We haven't been there yet,” she said. “We went around the stone hollows to the west. Houses there collect rainwater; they wanted salt, not our dried beans. Carried two sacks for nothing, and now we have to eat them ourselves.”
pairs.hanzi: “那边还没去。”她说，“我们绕的是西面的石洼。路上有几家收雨水的院子，开口要盐，不要我们带的干豆。白背来两袋，回来还得自己吃。”

pairs.target: ǎipàng nánrén zài pángbiān shuō yě búshì bái bèi , bànlù huàn le yídùn rèfàn .
pairs.english: The stout man said it was not all wasted; along the way they had traded some for a hot meal.
pairs.hanzi: 矮胖男人在旁边说也不是白背，半路换了一顿热饭。

pairs.target: nǚrén xiàomà tā yìwǎn fàn néng chuī sāntiān , ruò búshì tā bǎ jiàqián tīngcuò , nǎ yòng duō gěi yìbǎ zhēn .
pairs.english: Laughing, the woman accused him of boasting about one bowl for three days; if he had not misheard the price, they would not have paid an extra handful of needles.
pairs.hanzi: 女人笑骂他一碗饭能吹三天，若不是他把价钱听错，哪用多给一把针。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng dé xiǎng xiào , yòu shèbùdé lòudiào yíjù .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to laugh, yet could not bear to miss a word.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听得想笑，又舍不得漏掉一句。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi wèn dào yuèjiè kè , jiù néng xiàng xiānkāi chuānglián yíyàng kànjiàn lìngyìtóu , jiéguǒ xiān tīngjiàn yán , wàzi hé liǎngdài méi màichūqù de dòu .
pairs.english: He had imagined asking an Outrider would reveal the far side like drawing a curtain, but first he heard about salt, socks and two unsold sacks of beans.
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为问到越界客，就能像掀开窗帘一样看见另一头，结果先听见盐、袜子和两袋没卖出去的豆。

pairs.target: kě nǚrén ná guò bāo lǐ de pízhǐ , zhǐ gěi nánrén kàn yǔshuǐ yuànzi páng nà dào fēnchà , tā háishì bùyóu còujìn le xiē .
pairs.english: But when the woman took parchment from her pack and showed the man a fork beside the rainwater houses, he still could not help leaning closer.
pairs.hanzi: 可女人拿过包里的皮纸，指给男人看雨水院子旁那道分叉，他还是不由凑近了些。

pairs.target: tā zhùyì dào , zhuǎnguò zhǐ , ràng tā kàn dé zhèng xiē .
pairs.english: She noticed and turned the sheet so he could see it properly.
pairs.hanzi: 她注意到，转过纸，让他看得正些。

pairs.target: nà zhāng tú búshì suíshǒu néng wàng dàotóu de dàpiàn guótǔ , wānwānqūqǔ zhī huà zhe yíduàn shí wā , shuǐ cóng nǎlǐ xiàlái , nǎlǐ néng luòjiǎo , dōu jǐ zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: The map was no great expanse of territory taking in everything at a glance, only a winding stretch of stone hollows, with watercourses and resting places crowded together.
pairs.hanzi: 那张图不是随手能望到头的大片国土，弯弯曲曲只画着一段石洼，水从哪里下来，哪里能落脚，都挤在一起。

pairs.target: yǒu yìxiǎo chù quān le liǎngbiàn , nǚrén shuō yuánlái nà kuài péngdǐng yǐjīng tā le , búyào zài zhàojiù tú zǒu .
pairs.english: One small area was circled twice. The woman said the old shelter roof there had collapsed; they must not follow the old map again.
pairs.hanzi: 有一小处圈了两遍，女人说原来那块棚顶已经塌了，不要再照旧图走。

pairs.target: luó dí kàn le piànkè , wèn tāmen huí zhèn yào buyào jiè tángxiōng de yuànzi tān dōngxī , pénglǐ wǎnshàng lùshuǐ zhòng .
pairs.english: Luodi watched a moment and asked whether they wanted his cousin's courtyard to spread things out back in town; the shelter got heavy dew at night.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻看了片刻，问他们回镇要不要借堂兄的院子摊东西，棚里晚上露水重。

pairs.target: nǚrén shuō děng hòutou de rén dào le zài dìng , jiào tā bié xiān bǎ lùshang jiǎn de cǎo dài quán ná qù diàn chē .
pairs.english: The woman said they would decide once the others arrived, and told him not to use all the grass bands picked up on the road to pad carts meanwhile.
pairs.hanzi: 女人说等后头的人到了再定，叫他别先把路上捡的草带全拿去垫车。

pairs.target: líkāi shí , tǎ wéi huítóu kàn le hǎo jǐcì .
pairs.english: Leaving, Tavi looked back several times.
pairs.hanzi: 离开时，塔维回头看了好几次。

pairs.target: nǚrén yǐjīng chóngxīn zuòxià , zhèng tóng huǒbàn fēn yìxiǎokuài yìng bǐng , bái pái yā zài yījiǎo , méiyǒu suízhe tā měijùhuà xiǎng .
pairs.english: The woman had sat down again and was sharing a small hard cake with her companions, her white tally tucked under her coat edge rather than clattering with every word.
pairs.hanzi: 女人已经重新坐下，正同伙伴分一小块硬饼，白牌压在衣角，没有随着她每句话响。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngdào nài lěi chī guò de yìng miànbāo , hūrán hěn xiǎng jiāng jīntiān zhèjiàn shì xiěgěi tā .
pairs.english: He thought of Nerai's hard bread and suddenly wanted very much to write to her about today.
pairs.hanzi: 他想到奈蕾吃过的硬面包，忽然很想将今天这件事写给她。

pairs.target: luó dí zài qiántou jiào tā . shānlù jìntóu yǒu jǐkē jié xiǎo qīngguǒ de shù , tā zhāi le yìkē , pāo gěi tǎ wéi , shuō bié quán xiǎngzhe yuǎnchù , xiān chángcháng zhé tóng zhèbiān de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Luodi called from ahead. Trees bearing little green fruit grew at the path's end; he picked one and tossed it to Tavi, saying to stop thinking only of distant places and try something from Zhetong first.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻在前头叫他。山路尽头有几棵结小青果的树，他摘了一颗，抛给塔维，说别全想着远处，先尝尝折桐这边的东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎopò guǒpí , zhěngzhāng liǎn dōu zhòu le qǐlái .
pairs.english: Tavi bit through the skin, and his whole face puckered.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维咬破果皮，整张脸都皱了起来。

pairs.target: luó dí fú zhe shù xiào , xiào dào tǎ wéi shēnshǒu yào zhuā tā , cái shuō zhè guǒzǐ běnlái jiù gāi yān zhe chī .
pairs.english: Luodi leaned against a tree laughing until Tavi reached to grab him, then admitted the fruit was meant to be pickled before eating.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻扶着树笑，笑到塔维伸手要抓他，才说这果子本来就该腌着吃。

pairs.target: tā bátuǐ pǎo , tǎ wéi zhuī chūqù liǎngbù , zuǐlǐ réng suān dé shuō bùchéng yíjù wánzhěng dehuà .
pairs.english: He took off running. Tavi chased him two steps, his mouth still too sour to form a complete sentence.
pairs.hanzi: 他拔腿跑，塔维追出去两步，嘴里仍酸得说不成一句完整的话。
